character.name: Bella Bear
character.appearance: Bella is a small, round brown bear cub with soft honey-colored fur, warm dark eyes, and a gentle smile. She has a little cream-colored tummy patch and short rounded ears.

character.name: Oliver Fox
character.appearance: Oliver is a slim young fox with bright orange-red fur, a fluffy white-tipped tail, and perky triangular ears. He has clever amber eyes and a playful, confident grin.

character.name: Luna Owl
character.appearance: Luna is a small owl with soft lavender-grey feathers, big round golden eyes, and two tufted feathers above her head like little eyebrows. Her wings have a gentle speckled pattern.
character.catchphrase: Every question opens a new adventure!

character.name: Toby Turtle
character.appearance: Toby is a young sea turtle with a rounded teal-green shell patterned in soft swirls, gentle brown eyes, and smooth blue-green flippers. He has a calm, unhurried expression.

character.name: Max Monkey
character.appearance: Max is a small, energetic monkey with soft brown fur, a lighter tan face and belly, big curious eyes, and a long curling tail. He has an eager, wide-open smile.

character.name: Penny Penguin
character.appearance: Penny is a small round penguin with glossy black-and-white feathers, a bright orange beak, and orange webbed feet. She has rosy cheeks and a cheerful, energetic stance.
character.catchphrase: Healthy habits make every day fun!

character.name: Barnaby Bunny
character.appearance: Barnaby is a small, soft grey-and-white bunny with long floppy ears, round sleepy eyes, and a little pink nose. He has a plush, huggable, storybook-soft look.
character.catchphrase: Sweet dreams begin with a smile!
